description: This source file implements the Stop class for the webAudio task in the Rialto server project. It defines the constructor, destructor, and execute method for stopping the web audio pipeline by changing its state to NULL.

classes.name: Stop
classes.description: A class responsible for stopping the web audio pipeline by setting its state to NULL.

methods.description: Constructor that initializes the Stop object with a reference to the IGstWebAudioPlayerPrivate interface.

methods.name: Stop::~Stop
methods.description: Destructor that logs the completion of the Stop object lifecycle.

methods.name: Stop::execute
methods.description: Executes the stop operation by changing the pipeline state to NULL.
